body:
### Summary

In case of data loss on C: after a clean Windows system reset, I used to install all tools to D:, besides uv, like below:
```powershell
$env:UV_INSTALL_DIR = "D:\uv\bin"
$env:UV_CACHE_DIR = "D:\uv\cache"
$env:UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR = "D:\uv\python"
$env:UV_TOOL_DIR = "D:\uv\tools"
$env:UV_CONFIG_FILE = "D:\uv\uv.toml"
irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex
uv python install 3.11 --default
```
uv successfully goes into "D:\uv\bin" and python installations goes into "D:\uv\python". However, python.exe/python3.11.exe/python3.exe goes to ~/.local/bin/, instead of "D:\uv\bin".

### Platform

Windows 11 x86_64

### Version

uv v0.13.1 to v0.13.9

### Python version

Python 3.11.14
title: --default creates python*.exe to .local/bin instead of UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR
